pppower 0.0.0.9000
  • Reference

    Power curve for the PP mean estimator

    power_curve_mean.Rd

    Computes Monte Carlo power values for a grid of labeled sample sizes using simulate_power() given pre-computed variance components.

    power_curve_mean(
  n_grid,
  delta,
  N,
  var_f,
  var_res,
  alpha = 0.05,
  R = 10000,
  seed = NULL
)

    Arguments

    n_grid

    Integer vector of candidate labeled sample sizes.

    delta

    Effect size \(\theta - \theta_0\).

    N

    Unlabeled sample size.

    var_f

    Variance of \(f(X)\).

    var_res

    Variance of residuals \(Y - f(X)\).

    alpha

    Two-sided significance level.

    R

    Number of Monte Carlo replicates passed to simulate_power().

    seed

    Optional RNG seed for reproducibility.

    Value

    Data frame with columns n, power_empirical, power_exact, delta, N, alpha, var_f, and var_res ready for plotting power curves.

    Examples

    power_curve_mean(
  n_grid = seq(50, 200, by = 25),
  delta = 0.2,
  N = 2000,
  var_f = 0.4,
  var_res = 1.0,
  R = 5000,
  seed = 123
)
#>     n power_empirical power_exact delta    N alpha var_f var_res
#> 1  50          0.2898   0.2905906   0.2 2000  0.05   0.4       1
#> 2  75          0.4000   0.4049879   0.2 2000  0.05   0.4       1
#> 3 100          0.5116   0.5081511   0.2 2000  0.05   0.4       1
#> 4 125          0.5854   0.5982060   0.2 2000  0.05   0.4       1
#> 5 150          0.6656   0.6749441   0.2 2000  0.05   0.4       1
#> 6 175          0.7406   0.7391332   0.2 2000  0.05   0.4       1
#> 7 200          0.7918   0.7920460   0.2 2000  0.05   0.4       1
